description: This source file defines a custom annotation @DisableHandlers used within the OpenMRS project to disable specific data handlers on fields (collections) in Java classes. The annotation affects the behavior of the RequiredDataAdvice component during runtime, controlling which handlers should not be applied to annotated fields.

classes.name: DisableHandlers
classes.description: A custom Java annotation used to specify which RequiredDataHandler implementations should be disabled for a particular field.

methods.name: handlerTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of handler classes that should be disabled when this annotation is applied.
